title: Proposed study collaboration on metachromatic leukodystrophy

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on metachromatic leukodystrophy
Dear MLD Foundation, Cure MLD and ArchAngel MLD Trust team, each of you supports families living with metachromatic leukodystrophy.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea before it takes shape.
Published work describes the disease as a lysosomal enzyme deficiency in which sulfatides build up and damage myelin.
The Sanford rare disease registry is recruiting, and the HOME natural history study has been completed.
Gene therapy and OTL-200 trials have completed, a late juvenile OTL-200 trial is active but not recruiting, and atidarsagene autotemcel is already approved.
The atlas shows no contested points for these links, but its records cannot tell us what matters most to families.
We would propose [study aim and design], built with families from the start and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and tell us whether your community, or registries such as the Sanford registry, could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
Thank you for considering this, and for all you do for families.
